title: 4-Tier Hierarchical DI Scopes & Cascade Engine in Agent Frameworks

claims.assertion: Agent architectures must partition dependency injection across four strictly nested lifecycle scopes (App -> Workspace -> Session -> Agent) to enforce resource cleanup, prevent state cross-contamination between concurrent sessions, and isolate tool execution fibers

context: In multi-session agent runners or complex swarm architectures, flat service registries allow session-specific tokens, file watcher handles, or sub-agent execution state to bleed into global scope, causing race conditions, memory leaks, and broken session resets.
